speaker: Doctor
text: Since you mentioned a significant medical history, could you please describe your past diagnoses and any neurological symptoms you have experienced prior to this visit?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That description of appearing "drunk" while walking suggests cerebellar ataxia. Is this a new onset, or have you experienced episodes of dizziness, double vision, or difficulty speaking in the past? Also, do you have a history of head trauma, stroke, or long-term alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus PCR from cerebrospinal fluid.
